item.title: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro says on threats: "It weighs on me, but it doesn't control me"
item.description: Pennsylvania's Democratic Gov. You got to stand up against the hate. You've got to lead by example, and you've got to try and bring some decency back to this country."

item.title: Sen. Bernie Sanders says GOP rhetoric about El-Sayed "should appall every decent American"
item.description: Sen. Bernie Sanders told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that in the closely watched Michigan Senate race, the rhetoric he has seen from Republican surrogates about Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed is a "level of racism, absolutely overt racism," adding that he finds it "frankly disgusting and should appall every decent American."

item.title: Cuba in Crisis | Sunday on 60 Minutes
item.description:
This Sunday, 60 Minutes' Matt Gutman travels to Cuba to report on a country in freefall. The Trump administration imposed new economic sanctions that it says target Cuba's corrupt communist regime, restricting its oil supply and access to global trade.
As the humanitarian crisis deepens, more than 9 million Cubans are caught in the middle.

item.title: Endangered Republican Rep. Mike Lawler says "I show up, and my constituents know me"
item.description: Republican Rep. Mike Lawler of New York, who is in a tough reelection battle in a district won by Kamala Harris in 2024, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that he has bipartisan credentials despite his support for some of President Trump's signature policies, adding, "I show up for my constituents, and my constituents know me."

item.title: "The Lost Boys": How a vampire musical brings the undead to life
item.description: In movies and TV, vampires – the blood-sucking undead – have held a firm grip on the public's imagination. That popularity has now extended to Broadway. Correspondent Tracy Smith talks with actors L.J. Benet and Ali Louis Bourzgui, and director Michael Arden, of "The Lost Boys," which has avoided the stake in the heart that befell other Broadway vampire musicals. Smith also talks with film professor Rebekah McKendry about vampire lore in the media.
